answer.text: The key stays in while the ignition is ON because it can be removed only when the ignition is OFF or the steering is locked.

policy.text: The key can be removed only when the ignition is OFF or the steering is locked.
Do not switch the ignition OFF while riding.

watchouts.text: Do not switch the ignition OFF while riding. Doing so can cause a potential accident, resulting in serious injury to the rider and other road users, and severe damage to the motorcycle.
When the engine is not running, turn the ignition OFF. If it is left ON, the battery will discharge because the headlamp stays on.

watchout_review.reason: Switching OFF while riding is the obvious workaround and is dangerous.
